Journal 2469 was posted on 20240222, after period 1 closed on 20240205. Posting a new journal into the closed period is not allowed, so I can't touch period 1 itself. The standard fix for a closed-period posting is to reverse the entry in the first open period. That moves the effect of the late entry out of the closed period and into period 11.

The original journal is Dr 5500 279.22, Cr 2100 139.61, Cr 1200 139.61. Reversing it gives Dr 2100 139.61, Dr 1200 139.61, Cr 5500 279.22. That balances, uses only active accounts, and makes no invoice status change.

I considered re-posting the entry in the open period afterwards, but I can't tell whether the accrual is still wanted. The reversal is the smallest correction I can justify, so I am not re-posting it.
